desc:
Welcome to Venti Coffee Shop! ☕

🧑‍🍳 Become a barista and make handcrafted drinks for customers!
😎 Earn XP as a worker to level up and unlock new abilities!
☕ Order drinks and snacks from other players!
💼 Get promoted to manager and run the coffee shop!

🚀 Ready to become a Verified Barista? Follow these steps: 
1. Join the "Venti®" group!
2. In the game, select the lightbulb button on the left side of your screen, then click "Teleport to Application Center"
3. Pass the application
4. Get automatically ranked to Rookie Barista in the group! The more you play, the higher ranks in the group you earn!

⭐ Thanks for playing!
